zh-Hant.title: 從鎖定畫面直接開始錄音
zh-Hant.body: 長按鎖定畫面、點「自訂」，把左下或右下的按鈕換成 Parley 的「錄音」。之後按一下、解鎖，Parley 打開時就已經在錄了。
zh-Hant.also: 也可以放進控制中心、設成動作按鈕，或對 Siri 說「用 Parley 錄音」。

en.title: Start recording from the lock screen
en.body: Touch and hold the lock screen, tap Customize, and swap one of the bottom buttons for Parley's Record. Press it, unlock, and Parley opens already recording.
en.also: It also works from Control Center, the Action button, or by asking Siri to “Record with Parley”.
